summary: GRI 12 provides information for organizations in the coal sector about their likely material topics, based on the sector's most significant impacts on the economy, environment, and people. It lists disclosures to report for each topic, drawn from the GRI Topic Standards and other sources.

questions.text: Describe how the organization manages the material topic of climate change: its actual and potential impacts, policies and commitments, actions taken, how effectiveness is tracked, and stakeholder engagement (GRI 3-3).
questions.hint: Topic 12.1 Climate change.
